sloka: पुत्रः किल जवस्य अहम् माता मम  शतह्रदा ।विराध इति माम् आहुः पृथिव्याम् सर्व राक्षसाः ॥३-३-५॥
transliteration: putraḥ kila javasya aham mātā mama  śatahradā ।virādha iti mām āhuḥ pṛthivyām sarva rākṣasāḥ ॥3-3-5॥

translations.english: Then Viradha said to Rama whose truth was his strength, I will tell you who I am. O, listen:
